name: freight claims

product.purpose: Prepare source-linked claim packets for customer-confirmed freight loss, damage, or shortage, and track carrier response windows.
product.publication: The first ShipStation app listing is owner-reviewed. Glacier reads ShipStation only and never submits or sends a carrier claim.
product.billing: Prepare a 20–30% contingency invoice draft only after recovery is confirmed; customer agreement and owner approval are required before billing.

schedules.purpose: Read ShipStation shipment records daily and save possible exceptions for customer confirmation.
Collect due 30-day acknowledgment and 120-day resolution reminders.

your_steps.title: Connect ShipStation or add a shipments export
your_steps.detail: Choose either option. For automatic ShipStation reads, the account needs the Gold plan or higher: save its read-only API key in Glacier's keychain, check the current quota, explicitly enable polling, run the connection check, and review the first shipment list. If the account cannot use the API, download a ShipStation Shipments or Orders CSV and place it in this computer's freight-claims/incoming folder; the daily check uses the newest CSV automatically. You can also choose a file with the local watch command. Glacier never creates accounts, changes shipments, or publishes listings.

secrets.name: shipstation_api_key
secrets.label: ShipStation API key (only for API access)

your_steps.title: Review the first ten claim packets
your_steps.detail: The first ten distinct packets are blocked at an explicit Glacier owner approval. Compare each against its bill of lading, invoice, delivery receipt, photos, insurance status, and cited carrier terms. Later packets still require shipper review before sending.

your_steps.title: Review and respond to each claim
your_steps.when: After the shipper reviews a prepared packet
your_steps.detail: The shipper supplies owner-approved authorization, confirms claim details, and sends the packet. Record the carrier receipt and recovery. If a full-release settlement arrives, the shipper must explicitly accept or decline; acceptance closes the claim and decline leaves it active. Approve any invoice draft before it is sent or charged.

launch_gates: Owner reviews the first ShipStation app listing.
Owner reviews the first ten claim packets.
No carrier message, filing, signature, invoice, or payment is sent by Glacier without an exact approval step; real carrier submission remains with the shipper.
